name: Tea
description: A beverage made from the leaves of Camellia sinensis, cultivated and consumed in East Asia before spreading across Asia and eventually becoming a global commodity.

events.title: Tea was cultivated and consumed in China
events.description: Tea has a long history of cultivation and consumption in China, where traditions of tea drinking developed over many centuries.

events.title: Tea was introduced to Korea
events.description: Tea cultivation and consumption reached Korea through cultural and religious connections with China.

events.title: Tea was introduced to Japan
events.description: Tea was introduced to Japan from China, with Buddhist monks playing an important role in its early transmission.

events.title: Tea became popular in Britain
events.description: Tea became increasingly popular in Britain after being introduced through international trade, eventually becoming an important part of British culture.

events.title: Commercial tea cultivation developed in India
events.description: Large-scale commercial tea cultivation developed in India during the British colonial period.

events.title: Commercial tea cultivation expanded in Sri Lanka
events.description: Commercial tea cultivation expanded rapidly in Sri Lanka during the nineteenth century.
